description: Choose GitHub activity or share a contribution in your own words.
help: Choose what to share. GitHub activity is optional, and you can add a contribution without connecting an account.
highlightsHelp: A small improvement, a review, documentation, or helping a community all count. Choose a contribution and add context in your own words; your explanation will appear in the README.

activity.title: GitHub activity (optional)
activity.help: Choose optional activity cards and customize their appearance. Your public activity does not measure what you know.
activity.usernameHelp: Only the username, with or without @. We query GitHub when you choose to.
activity.queryFirst: Check your GitHub username to enable profile cards. Resource cards can be configured separately below. Nothing is selected automatically.
activity.choose: What would you like to include?
activity.extendedAttribution: Cards adapted from <project>GitHub Stats Extended</project> under the MIT license. This site renders them locally using public data. Configure statistics, languages, resources, and appearance below.

calendar.label: Contribution calendar
calendar.help: Contributions over the last year, without streaks or rankings.

summary.label: Activity summary
summary.help: Commits, pull requests, issues, and reviews for the same period.

languages.label: Repository languages
languages.help: Languages by code size in your public, non-fork repositories. This is not a skills assessment.

panorama.label: Activity panorama
panorama.help: Calendar and summary for the period, alongside the current language distribution of your public repositories.

monthly.label: Activity by month
monthly.help: Monthly contribution counts from the calendar. The first and last months may cover only part of the month.

extended-stats.label: Extended activity summary
extended-stats.help: Choose public activity counters, repository filters, and an optional activity rank. A rank is not a skills assessment.

extended-languages.label: Extended repository languages
extended-languages.help: Choose language layouts, filters, weights, and display options for public repositories. This is not a skills assessment.

appearance.title: Card appearance
appearance.help: These choices apply to all selected cards and are saved in your project. The card theme is independent of the editor theme.

size.label: Card width
size.help: Cards fit the available space in the preview.

preset.label: Extended color theme
preset.help: Theme names come from GitHub Stats Extended. Custom colors below take precedence. The base theme uses the theme and palette above.

advanced.title: Advanced appearance
advanced.help: These options apply to supported parts of the selected cards. Custom text is published in the README card. Review color contrast in the preview.
advanced.customTitleHelp: Optional, up to 100 characters. Leave empty for the card's title.
advanced.widthHelp: The image still fits the available space in the preview.
advanced.colorsHelp: Optional colors use #RRGGBB. Clear a field and apply to use its theme color. Custom colors override theme colors.
advanced.colorError: Use a six-digit hexadecimal color, such as #336699, or leave empty.
advanced.gradientHelp: Two to ten #RRGGBB colors, separated by commas or new lines. Clear the list and apply to remove the gradient.
advanced.gradientError: Use two to ten valid #RRGGBB colors and an angle between 0 and 360.
advanced.draftHelp: Color text is saved only after applying valid values. Invalid text stays here for correction.

extended.title: Extended statistics and language options
extended.help: Settings are saved in your project. Editing does not query GitHub; selected card images request their configured data. Some counters cover different periods, and filters may make a metric unavailable or partial.
extended.statsItemsHelp: Choose at least one. Missing public data is shown as unavailable rather than zero.

stats.repositoriesContributedTo: Repositories contributed to in the period

extended.includeOwn: Include own repositories in contributed repository counts
extended.includeOwnHelp: Extended excludes your own repositories from those counters by default.
extended.rankHelp: The letter or percentile comes from Extended's activity formula. It is not an official GitHub rating and does not measure ability, experience, or code quality. It is hidden when the required public data is unavailable.
extended.weightHelp: Weights change the distribution formula, not skill levels. Defaults: code size 1, repository count 0.
extended.weightError: Use weights between 0 and 2, with at least one weight greater than zero.
extended.languageListHelp: Up to 20 language names, separated by commas or new lines. Apply to save; an empty list removes this filter.
extended.languageListError: Enter up to 20 distinct language names, each up to 100 characters.

filters.title: Public repository filters
filters.help: Filters apply where GitHub supports them. Historical totals can be limited or partial; cards identify those cases. Only public repositories are used.
filters.repositoriesHelp: Up to 20 owner/repository pairs, separated by commas or new lines. Leave empty for the available repository set.
filters.ownersHelp: Up to 20 GitHub user or organization names, separated by commas or new lines.
filters.excludeRepositoriesHelp: Up to 20 repository names without owner/. For statistics this affects stars; for languages it affects the language sample.
filters.error: Check the lists: up to 20 distinct entries each. Repositories use owner/name; owners and excluded names must be valid GitHub names.

resources.title: Extended repository, Gist, and WakaTime cards
resources.help: Configure public resources independently of your GitHub profile username. Apply a target before selecting its card. Selected images query that public resource; editing these fields does not query it.
resources.missingTarget: Add and apply a valid target for this selected card, or deselect the card.

contributions.title: A user's contributions in each repository
contributions.help: Add optional public history counters to each repository card. Commented and reviewed counters exclude items authored by that user. Results may be limited by GitHub's available public history. Editing does not query GitHub; apply valid settings to save them.
contributions.usernameHelp: Optional and independent of the profile username. Use a GitHub username without @. Choose counters below, or clear them all to leave out contributions.
contributions.usernameRequired: Enter a GitHub username to apply the selected contribution counters.
contributions.invalidUsername: Enter a valid GitHub username of up to 39 letters, digits, or single hyphens between them, without @.

repositories.title: Public repositories
repositories.label: Repository targets
repositories.help: Up to 12 distinct owner/repository pairs, separated by commas or new lines. One card is generated per repository.
repositories.error: Use up to 12 distinct valid owner/repository pairs.
repositories.cardHelp: Public repository descriptions, language, stars, and forks. No private repositories are requested.

gists.title: Public Gists
gists.label: Gist IDs
gists.help: Up to 12 distinct hexadecimal Gist IDs, separated by commas or new lines. Use the ID from the public Gist URL, not the whole URL.
gists.error: Use up to 12 distinct hexadecimal Gist IDs of 5–64 characters.
gists.cardHelp: One card per public Gist. Secret Gists are not displayed.

wakatimeUsername.title: Public WakaTime activity
wakatimeUsername.label: WakaTime username
wakatimeUsername.help: Use your existing WakaTime username (letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens; up to 64 characters), not the alias current. Its public coding activity and public languages must already be enabled in WakaTime. This site does not create an account or request a WakaTime token.
wakatimeUsername.error: Use an explicit WakaTime username of 1–64 letters, digits, underscores, or hyphens. The alias current is not supported.
wakatimeUsername.cardHelp: Uses public coding activity from WakaTime. This username is independent of your GitHub username.

options.title: Resource card details
options.showOwner: Show the repository or Gist owner
options.hideLanguagesHelp: Up to 20 distinct language names, separated by commas or new lines. Apply to save; an empty list removes the filter.
options.hideLanguagesError: Use up to 20 distinct language names of up to 100 characters.

activity.scope: Cards use the activity GitHub makes available. They can be left out or removed at any time.
activity.empty: No contributions were found for this period. You can still share technologies, projects, or contributions in your own words.
activity.stale: Showing the last available data. It may have changed on GitHub.
activity.privateCounts: The calendar includes anonymous counts of private contributions. Private details are not shown.
activity.languageLimit: Languages cover {analyzed} of {total} repositories because of the query limit.

errors.invalid_username: Enter a valid GitHub username, with or without @, up to 39 characters. Use letters, numbers, or single hyphens between them.
errors.not_found: We could not find that GitHub account. Check the username and try again.
errors.not_configured: GitHub activity is not enabled on this instance yet. You can still add your featured contributions below.
errors.rate_limited: GitHub's request limit was reached. Try again later; you can keep editing your profile.
errors.unavailable: GitHub activity could not be loaded. Try again; you can keep editing your profile.

empty: Add a way you have helped a project, a person, or a community.
title: Contribution title
titleHelp: Name your contribution, or leave this empty and describe it below.
descriptionHelp: Optional. Explain what you contributed or why it matters to you. This text is published in the README.
descriptionPlaceholder: Reviewed setup instructions and helped new learners get started.
urlHelp: Optional. Use a full http:// or https:// address, without spaces or sign-in credentials.
invalidUrl: Enter a valid http:// or https:// address without spaces or sign-in credentials, or leave this field empty.
removeHelp: Removing this entry deletes its title, description, and link from your draft. Hide the section instead to keep them.
